description: Georgia is the first state in the nation to pass a statewide legislative measure linking the arts to improved mental health outcomes, co-sponsored by three House Democrats (Kim Schofield, D-Atlanta/College Park; Mary Margaret Oliver D- Decatur; and Lydia Glaize D-Fairburn) and three House Republicans (Todd Jones, R-South Forsyth; Katie Dempsey R-Rome; and Angie O’Steen R-Ambrose).
